description: Pause / Observation Pack. No new capability. No runtime. No L6. Snapshot of current L4/L5 state, forbidden boundaries, resume entry points, observation checklist. 0 src change. 0 fixture mutation.

l5_entry_point.pattern: NEW pure file (per 008I design; no in-place mutation of existing chain)
l5_entry_point.side_effects: none (pure function; no I/O; no IPC; no spawn; no fetch; no in-place chain mutation)

feature_flag.name: KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED
feature_flag.scope: Surface B task prompt preamble + 008J task dispatch prompt builder entry point
feature_flag.behavior_when_disabled: 008J builder returns base task prompt verbatim; no preamble; fallback L4
feature_flag.behavior_when_enabled_and_trigger_fired: preamble attached; knowledge_contract_attached=true; 4 runtime flags literal false; no_l6=true
does_not_affect: IPC / gateway / serve / run / agent / delegate / playbook / cron

not_go_matrix.real_agent_subprocess: NOT-GO (spawn / child_process / runPlaybook / sendMessage all forbidden)
not_go_matrix.real_runtime_dispatch_invocation: NOT-GO (008J+ chain integration留 008+ 显式批)
not_go_matrix.live_knowledge_search: NOT-GO (L6留 separate ADR + 显式批)
not_go_matrix.live_knowledge_ingest: NOT-GO (L6留 separate ADR + 显式批)
not_go_matrix.live_flush: NOT-GO (L6留 separate ADR + 显式批)

resume_branches.name: Renderer GateCard Implementation
resume_branches.isolation: UI 独立线; 不动 L5 main-side entry point

resume_branches.name: L6 Live Adapter Design Only (no implementation)
resume_branches.scope: design real IPC adapter (Handoff Pack / audit log / 幂等 / rate limit / rollback); L6 live search / live flush / knowledgeSearch / knowledgeIngest
resume_branches.depends_on: 008L closeout (L5 task dispatch prompt builder stable)
resume_branches.isolation: design only; 0 implementation; 0 src change; 0 spawn / 0 IPC / 0 ingest / 0 flush

resume_branches.name: 008J+ Chain Integration (real runtime dispatch invocation)
resume_branches.scope: wire 008J builder output into existing dispatch chain
resume_branches.depends_on: 008L closeout (L5 task dispatch prompt builder stable)
resume_branches.isolation: in-place mutation forbidden (008I design); only NEW file additions to dispatch chain

resume_branches.name: Surface C Default System Prompt Fragment (Phase 2)
resume_branches.scope: default system prompt fragment (mutate CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / Hermes default)
resume_branches.trigger: L5 task dispatch prompt builder stable + user explicit approval + separate ADR
resume_branches.isolation: not recommended as first step; high blast radius; touches locked files

observation_checklist.check: Claude Code / Codex / Hermes Pro 是否仍询问 Obsidian Vault / MEMORY.md / .wolf/cerebrum.md / notes/<topic>.md 路径
observation_checklist.expected: 否 (008J builder preamble 含 007I 'Do not write to MEMORY.md' 等禁止条款)

observation_checklist.check: 是否误声称已保存 (已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm)
observation_checklist.expected: 否 (008J builder preamble 排除 5 句 deceptive copy)

observation_checklist.check: source_uri / fetched_at 是否漂移 (007I 强调 verbatim)
observation_checklist.expected: no drift (008J builder 是 prepend-only, 不 mutate base task prompt)

observation_checklist.check: ordinary code task (fix bug / refactor / rename) 是否被误注入
observation_checklist.expected: 否 (008J builder 0 trigger → skip no_trigger_fired, fallback L4)

observation_checklist.check: feature flag KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED 是否保持 default false
4 runtime flags 是否保持 literal false
observation_checklist.expected: 是 (008J output runtime_flush_allowed / runtime_dispatch_allowed / real_handoff_write_allowed / live_adapter_allowed 都为 false)

observation_checklist.check: no_l6 字段是否保持 true literal
mtime guard baseline 是否保持不变

rollback_during_pause.no_code_to_revert: 008J builder 是 NEW file; 既存在文件 0 修改
rollback_during_pause.feature_flag_off_immediate: set KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED=false at evaluation point; 008J builder returns base task prompt verbatim; no in-place chain mutation needed
rollback_during_pause.fall_back_to_L4: 008J builder returns base; HCC handoff payload's payload.context.contracts.knowledge_reuse still works as data contract; L4 behavior fully preserved
